title: YouTube is making comments more fun — and fandom more lucrative for creators | TechCrunch
summary: Hype , a feature that lets fans recommend smaller creators’ videos to others and climb fan leaderboards, will gain new functionality dubbed “Hype with Jewels.” Previously, fans could only “hype” videos three times per week for free.
